note: Counts and dates for what each NDJSON file in this directory holds. CI cross-checks these numbers against the file and against the built index, so a drop that lost records fails the publish instead of quietly shipping.

wordpress.coverageNote: browse=new is the only sort that enumerates the directory exactly; browse=popular ties on active_installs and yields 50,126 distinct slugs of a claimed 64,947. Duplicates come from plugins added mid-run shifting the offsets, which repeats records rather than skipping them.

joomla.source: extensions.joomla.org Algolia index (jed_live), enumerated in 287 core_catid slices
joomla.coverageNote: The directory reports 5,610 and all 5,610 were fetched. Six are not published because JED declares no extension type for them - their Includes badge row is empty on the listing page itself - and kind is a required field with no honest default. They are named in data/joomla.export-report.json. Algolia caps pagination at 1,000 hits and refuses the browse endpoint to a search-only key, so paging the index straight through returns 1,000 of 5,610 with an HTTP 200 for every request; core_catid partitions the index exactly and every slice fits under the cap.

shopify.source: apps.shopify.com listing pages, enriched with third-party-measured install counts
shopify.coverageNote: 25969 of 25468 listed apps. The App Store has no bulk endpoint and rate-limits hard, so the crawl is built up across scheduled passes rather than in one; read coverageVsDirectory before comparing this platform with the others. Apps the measurement provider has not observed carry no activeInstalls field rather than a zero.

sources.directory-reported: published by the marketplace itself, usually in buckets

excluded.note: Descriptions, changelogs and marketing copy belong to the extension authors and are not republished. No data supplier is named anywhere in the output, ever.

measuredMetrics.policy: activeInstalls for shopify may be published when it carries activeInstallsSource: third-party-measured. No other licensed metric is published, and no supplier is named.
measuredMetrics.whyThisIsADecisionAndNotADefault: This file previously read licensedMetrics: always, meaning no metric obtained under a commercial licence was published at all. Publishing here is not display: dist/ is released CC BY 4.0, which grants third parties an irrevocable licence to redistribute the numbers. That is a commercial and legal judgement about the supplier agreement, made by the project owner, not a technical default.
measuredMetrics.exercisedNote: In effect since 2026-08-04: 249 published shopify records carry activeInstalls with activeInstallsSource: third-party-measured.
measuredMetrics.whyShopifyOnly: wordpress.org and the Joomla Extensions Directory publish their own adoption figures, which carry activeInstallsSource: directory-reported and are not licensed. The Shopify App Store publishes no install figure at all, so a measurement is the only source of one.
measuredMetrics.absentIsNotZero: An app the measurement provider did not observe is published with no activeInstalls field. It is never published as zero: 'not observed' and 'has no installs' are different claims and only the first is known.
